meta.title: Highland Sanctuary
meta.tagline: Establish a mountain community while preserving alpine biomass.
meta.brief: Lead an expedition into a highland basin. Establish a secure settlement, build sustainable water and food reserves, and maintain high ecological biomass across your territory.
meta.author: Antigravity Stewardship Collective

constraints: Hold positive food and water reserves for 12 consecutive months

policyConstraints.rationale: Highland Sanctuary requires close stewardship to prevent ecological degradation.

customMessages.expeditionFailed: The mountain expedition failed to establish a settlement before winter set in.
customMessages.depopulated: The population fell below sustainable numbers.
customMessages.ecologicalCollapse: Severe erosion and environmental degradation rendered the sanctuary uninhabitable.
